[[File:Bruce Savin portrait.jpg|thumb|right|260px|Bruce Savin.]]
'''Bruce Savin''' (also published as '''Bruce Savins''') was a Decipher-era [[Squadron Members|Squadron Member]], listed as Rogue 9 from Gloucester, UK. The published fan table marks the slot Retired after Decipher's SWCCG run. Bruce Savin also played at [[1999 Naboo Regionals]] on 12 September 1999 with Eloms/non-unique aliens, according to Mike Kessling's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d38">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/1999-09-13-naboo-reigonal-england-9-12-99d38/ naboo-reigonal-england-9-12-99], DeckTech (Mike "Kessling" Kessling, 13 September 1999). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261031103129/https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/1999-09-13-naboo-reigonal-england-9-12-99d38/ Internet Archive].</ref>

Decipher recruited volunteer Squadron Members in the 1990s to promote SWCCG locally (tournaments, demos, player support).
